run_init_experiment: run the autoresearch init command to create a new experiment workdir with config and state files
parse_args_init: parse command line arguments for initializing an autoresearch experiment with workdir and optional flags
create_experiment_workdir: create an experiment working directory with runs and logs subdirectories and initial config
initialize_experiment_state: initialize experiment state with iteration zero status and empty history for tracking progress
setup_experiment_config: setup experiment configuration with pipeline script build command and stopping criteria parameters
